_note: The eight trigrams (Later Heaven / compass arrangement) plus the center, each with its compass direction, element, and the life area it governs. This shared table is what makes 'schools conflict' visible: the compass schools place these by direction, BTB places the SAME life areas by the front-door wall. Used by src/bagua.py; asserted in Week 2. Life-area names follow the common nine-aspiration bagua.

btb_grid._note: The BTB (Black Sect) three-door bagua. The grid is anchored to the wall containing the front door, which is ALWAYS the bottom row. Rows top-to-bottom, columns left-to-right, as you stand in the doorway looking in.
